title: DSA — Medium Tier
description: Sliding window, trees, BST, recursion, greedy, binary search, prefix sums. Codility middle problems + Andela HR harder challenges + Turing live coding.

questions.prompt: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters.
Longest Repeating Character Replacement: choose the best char and replace ≤ k others to maximize substring length.
3Sum: find all unique triplets summing to 0.
Search in Rotated Sorted Array.
Subarray Sum Equals K: count contiguous subarrays that sum to k.
Binary Tree Level Order Traversal.
Validate Binary Search Tree.
Generate All Permutations of a distinct array.
Jump Game: given nums[i] = max jump length from i, can you reach end?
Codility TieRopes: given rope lengths, min length K after tying adjacent → max number of ropes ≥ K.
Daily Temperatures: for each day, days until warmer temp. Monotonic stack.
Codility Dominator: find the dominator (>N/2 occurrences), return its index.
Maximum Subarray (Kadane's algorithm).
Detect Cycle in Linked List (return true/false).
Lowest Common Ancestor in a Binary Tree.
Number of Islands (grid of 0/1, count 4-connected components of 1s).
Climbing Stairs: n steps, take 1 or 2 at a time — how many distinct ways?
House Robber: max sum from non-adjacent elements.
Top K Frequent Elements.
Longest Consecutive Sequence in an unsorted array — O(n).
